_note: S183 — the goblin tower's 24-frame damage ramp, built by scripts/build-alpha-sheet-atlas.mjs.
The SOURCE is the owner's 8x3 contact sheet read in reading order as one continuous ramp,
frame 1 pristine to frame 24 rubble. The OUTPUT is 2 rows of 12, the shape the rest of the
pipeline is built around (ART_PIPELINE.md: 'it needs 12 frames'). states[] is the only place
This is the ALPHA intake, not the hub's: the sheet arrives RGBA with the cut-out already in
the alpha channel, with no drawn rules and no baked frame numbers. stripCornerLabel is
therefore FALSE — measured, the top-left corner of this sheet holds artwork, not numerals.
grid{} is an ASSERTION against the detected transparent gutters, never the source of the cell
bounds. MEASURED row heights on this sheet: 285 / 263 / 216 — a uniform 793/3 = 264 stride
visibly cuts the top off row 1.
ticksPerFrame 3 is HUB_RAMP_TICKS_PER_FRAME in src/render/structureRamp.ts and is pinned
against this file by structureRampAtlas.test.ts. 24 frames x 3 = 72 ticks = 1.2 s (R182-D).
